title: Magnetic Separation & Mining
painPoint: Magnetic separation is critical in mining and mineral processing for recovering ferrous contaminants, concentrating iron ore, and purifying industrial minerals. However, NdFeB magnets in drum and roll separators face extreme mechanical wear from abrasive ore slurries and impact loads from oversized feed material. High-throughput operations generate elevated temperatures that push standard N48 and N52 grades toward irreversible demagnetization, while acidic process water and saline environments accelerate corrosion of nickel-copper-nickel coatings. Engineers struggle to maintain peak magnetic field strength above 12,000 gauss while ensuring magnet assemblies survive 8,000-plus operating hours between maintenance cycles in harsh, remote mining installations.
